decision_execution: Existing current distinct-marker GPU predicate, once per batch
terminal_score_override: Only exact terminal rectangles are emitted; no pose score/status/residual is computed
row_order: Grouped by GPU, then per-GPU batch ordinal; not global chronology
clock: Host perf_counter, seconds relative to recording start; not a cross-device CUDA clock
timing_semantics: Includes synchronous device-to-host observation and recording overhead; never a GPU performance benchmark
depth_semantics: Exact generation from observed seed roots and mechanical midpoint child rectangles, not width inference
parent_id_semantics: Zero-based observed row ID; -1 for observed roots
root_id_semantics: Original GPU seed index, root_id = x_index * ny + y_index
representative_graph_semantics: First available state0/2/3/4 per GPU with valid proof metadata and zero flags; retained graph feasibility is not a location certificate
matched_prefix_semantics: Successfully augmented report prefix, not maximum partial cardinality on failure
input_source_and_cache_preservation: Owned by the external launch wrapper; this recorder never writes prepared caches
